chunks: On (this night) the angels and grace descend by the dispensation of their Lord, for settling all affairs.

key_terms.بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم: By the permission/command of their Lord
key_terms.وَالرُّوحُ: And the Spirit (often identified as Gabriel or the divine spirit)

ai.seo_question: What happens during the Night of Qadr according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the cosmic significance of Laylat al-Qadr as the night when divine decrees for the coming year are finalized and angels descend to execute God's commands. The term 'Ruh' is often interpreted by scholars as referring to the Archangel Gabriel or the Prophet Muhammad himself, emphasizing the transmission of revelation and spiritual guidance. This descent marks a pivotal moment of mercy and destiny, connecting the celestial realm with earthly affairs through divine permission.
